notes.title: Eleanor's Handmaid announced!
notes.notes:
The fourth game by Arcus Plume is a light-hearted visual novel about a young noblewoman and her handmaid who are starting to take an interest in [i]adult stuff[/i]. It is a story about close but platonic relationships turning into physical ones. It is also a story about... well, all right... everyone being horny all the time. Who would have guessed?

Although Eleanor's Handmaid is not a direct sequel to Succubus Research Diary, the two games have some connections. Julie D'Faerwyn, the mother of the new game's protagonist, made a brief but [i]passionate[/i] appearance in the Serena's Services story arc of Succubus Research Diary (updates 1.4 and 1.5). Everyone's favorite pink-haired succubus, Nerisha, will in turn have a role in Eleanor's Handmaid.

Check out the new game below. And please consider adding it to your wishlist. ːheart_of_succubusː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2339380/Eleanors_Handmaid/

notes.title: Version 1.5.1
notes.notes: A small [i]post-final[/i](?) update that fixes a bunch of typos and grammatical errors in the final content update. ːunit_of_manaː

notes.title: Version 1.5.0: The Grand Finale
notes.notes:
[b]The Serena's Services story arc ends with a bang![/b] ːstar_of_masteryː ([i]Disclaimer: no explosions included.[/i])

This content update isn't called The Grand Finale for no reason. It's not only the final update but also easily the biggest one. With a word count of over 11000 words, it's approximately as big as the two previous updates combined! Of course, there's plenty of new art as well!

The mysterious noblewoman [b]Lady Julie[/b] was briefly seen in the previous update, but now it's time for her to get into action. Be warned that she's a woman who can't be easily stopped once she has gotten started... ːheart_of_succubusː

[i]New things in a nutshell:[/i]
[list]
[*]New character and event art
[*]Lady Julie starring in the new 11000 word story
[*]New achievements
[/list]
[i]Other changes and fixes:[/i]
[list]
[*]A handful of typos fixed in previously released content
[*]Some small tweaks to in-game menus
[/list]
[i]How to access the new content?[/i]

[b]Serena's Services[/b] can be accessed after reaching [b]Ending 1[/b]. You'll have to play most of the previously released episodes to unlock the final episodes. If you have already done so, Episodes 7 and 8 are waiting for you!

[i]In other news[/i]
[list]
[*]Arcus Plume has a newly-opened [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/arcusplume]developer page[/url] on Steam. You'll get a notification of new releases if you click the follow button. 
[*]The next Arcus Plume game will be announced in Q1 2023. Lady Julie is one of the major characters of the game! Who knows if there will be other familiar faces as well...
[/list]

[i]And finally...[/i]

Have fun playing The Grand Finale. ːstar_of_masteryː

As always, comments and reviews are much appreciated. ːheart_of_succubusː

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Final Update
notes.notes: The biggest, sexiest, and finalest update is just around the corner! Approximately 85% complete at the time of writing this, the update will be [b]ready for release in early December[/b]. It will be more than twice as big as the previous content update and feature the enigmatic [b]Lady Julie[/b]. The Serena's Services story arc will finally reach its conclusion! Stay tuned! ːstar_of_masteryː

notes.title: Version 1.4.0: An Old Friend
notes.notes:
[i]Sometimes, a chance encounter with an old friend may open up new possibilities. What lies in store for Serena and Nerisha? Only time will tell...[/i]

It's the [b]first anniversary[/b] of the release of Succubus Research Diary, and here's a little something to celebrate it: the [b]fourth content update[/b]! This update adds two more episodes to the "Serena's Services" story arc and introduces two new characters to the game! ːheart_of_succubusː

[i]New things in a nutshell:[/i]
[list]
    [*]New character and event art
    [*]New 4500 word story featuring [b]Denice[/b] and [b]Julie[/b]
    [*]New achievements
[/list]
[i]How to access the new content?[/i]

Serena's Services can be accessed after reaching [b]Ending 1[/b]. Playing episodes 1 and 3 will unlock the newest episodes. [spoiler]2 and 4 are not required for mysterious reasons.[/spoiler]

ːwing_leftː Have fun! ːwing_rightː

notes.title: The Story Continues
notes.notes:
If you're an enthusiastic succubus researcher, there is good news and good news for you. No bad news at all. Yay! ːheart_of_succubusː

The first piece of good news is that Succubus Research Diary will get still get at least two more free content updates. The next update is coming out in early September!

[b]September 6, 2022:  ːstar_of_masteryː Version 1.4.0: An Old Friend[/b] ːstar_of_masteryː

The release date (or even month) of the fifth content update, however, is still yet to be decided, because it will connect the story of Succubus Research Diary with the yet-to-be-announced next Arcus Plume game. The update will probably come out shortly after the announcement of the new game.

The second piece of good news is that Serena and Nerisha will make their appearance in the above-mentioned next game as well! [spoiler]Not as major characters, though.[/spoiler] ːwing_leftː ːwing_rightː How do they end up in that game? Play the upcoming updates to find out!

notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.notes: This is a small update that corrects a couple of dozen grammatical errors and typos. ːunit_of_manaː

notes.title: Version 1.3.0: Nerisha's Services
notes.notes:
[b]It's Nerisha's turn to be the protagonist![/b] The story so far has been told almost exclusively from Serena's point of view. But not this time! It's time for the cute succubus Nerisha to bask in the spotlight! Oh, and she will also meet Jenny for the first time. And not [i]only[/i] meet her... ːheart_of_succubusː

[b]Nerisha's Services[/b] is essentially a sequel to Serena's Services (added in version 1.2.0). To Nerisha's dismay, the new content can be found in the Serena's Services submenu.

[i]New things in a nutshell:[/i]
[list]
    [*]New event art
    [*]New 7000 word story featuring Nerisha as the protagonist! ːstar_of_masteryː
    [*]New achievements
[/list]
[i]How to access the new content?[/i]

The Serena's Services submenu can be accessed after reaching [b]Ending 1[/b]. Nerisha's Services becomes available after playing the first episode of Serena's Services. The final episode requires you to play all other episodes first.

[b]P.S.[/b] Nerisha's Services along with the earlier added Serena's services expanded the story in a new direction as well as introduced a new character to the game. What did you think about these two updates? Consider mentioning them in a review or post your thoughts in the new [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1495000/discussions/0/3283695676283452462/]feedback thread[/url].  ːhorn_leftː ːhorn_rightː

notes.title: Trading Cards & Update News
notes.notes:
[h2]Trading cards[/h2]

Succubus Research Diary became eligible for the virtual goodies known as Steam Community Items a while ago. And now they are ready and approved for release! If you are planning on exploring the Underground, take some Trading Cards, Badges, Emoticons, and Profile Backgrounds with you. That's what the renowned explorer Serena would certainly [spoiler]not[/spoiler] do!

[list]
[*]The trading cards feature the main characters and the rooms of Nerisha's home.
[*]The badges are modeled after Nerisha's garden plants.
[*]The backgrounds feature Serena and Nerisha, Underground scenery, and decorative plant designs.
[*]The emoticons are succubus-themed items such as horns, wings, and hearts.
[/list]
You can also find the profile background and emoticons in the Points Shop (if you can't find them in there, please check your adult content settings).

[h2]Update News[/h2]

Succubus Research Diary will get another content update in April. The upcoming update is related to Serena's Services (added in update 1.2.0). Rumor has it that Nerisha will have a big role this time... ːheart_of_succubusː

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Serena's Services
notes.notes:
The second content update is here! Serena's Services expands the story in a new direction as well as introduces [b]a new character, Jenny[/b], to the game.

What does Serena do to make the big bucks and what does it have to do with Jenny? It's time to find out!

[i]New and shiny things:[/i]
[list]
[*]New character, background, and event art
[*]New 5000 word story about Serena's business with Jenny
[*]New achievements
[/list]
[i]How to access the new content?[/i]

You will find "Serena's Services" in the main menu of the game. If you have already reached [b]Ending 1[/b], you can access the new content right away. If not... well, you know what to do. :) [spoiler]Or not do. :([/spoiler]

notes.title: Coming Soon: Serena's Services
notes.notes: Succubus Research Diary will get another content update in early December. The upcoming update will add a new short story (split into two episodes) that takes place after Ending 1. The story will be entirely focused on Serena's secondary profession (whatever that might be...) and it will introduce a [b]new character[/b] to the game! [spoiler]Her name is Jenny.[/spoiler]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0: Little Epilogues
notes.notes:
This is a content update that adds epilogues to the game: one for each ending. Find out what Serena and Nerisha are up to shortly after the endings!

This update adds the following:
[list]
[*]More content: approx. 5000 words and 3 event CGs (+23 variants)
[*]2 new achievements
[*]New functionality in the 'Sex Scenes' gallery: shortcuts to endings and epilogues
[/list]
There are two ways to access the new content:
[olist]
[*]Reach an ending and you'll see a new choice that leads to the respective epilogue.
[*]If you have already reached at least one ending, you'll find a new button in the 'Sex Scenes' gallery that opens a list of shortcuts that lead to the endings and epilogues.
[/olist]
[i]May your mana reserves be sufficient.[/i]

notes.title: Coming Soon: Little Epilogues
notes.notes: Succubus Research Diary will get a content update in a couple of weeks. As the title suggests, the upcoming update will add epilogues to the game: one for each ending. It is to be expected that Serena and Nerisha will have some "non-platonic fun" in these follow-up episodes...

notes.title: Succubus Research Diary will be released on September 6th!
notes.notes: Succubus Research Diary finally has a release date. Although it's not [i]quite[/i] in late August as earlier planned, it's still in the very near future. Only three weeks now until the exciting, erotic, and adult-rated adventures of Serena and Nerisha can begin! Prepare yourself to dive into the mysterious Underground where you can learn what happens when an exceptionally seductive human meets a totally inexperienced succubus...

notes.title: Release postponed to August
notes.notes:
Succubus Research Diary will be released in August instead of June. There are mainly two reasons for this change. First, the earlier estimate was too optimistic (not to say unrealistic) to begin with. Second, the game will be somewhat longer than initially planned.

I believe that the extra time investment is worth it to make Succubus Research Diary a better game.

Thank you for your patience [strike](if you have any to spare)[/strike].

-[i]kuroha238[/i] (developer)
